_README: Prices move. Every entry carries the date it was last checked and the page it was checked against. report/build.ts prints the oldest verifiedOn on the grid and warns above 30 days, because a cost-per-resolved-unit table quoting stale prices is worse than one quoting none. Entries below are PLACEHOLDERS seeded to make the harness runnable — verify each against the provider's own pricing page before showing this to anyone, then set verified to true.

usdInr.note: Set to your own treasury rate. Every INR figure scales linearly with this.

models.source: local inference; set non-zero to amortise GPU + power
